name: Colony Timber
description: The wood of the timber trees planted by the first colony waves.
role: The first building material of every frontier outpost, and the most traded raw good on colony worlds.

artBrief.detail: Warm brown bark in vertical strips with pale cut rings.
distinctiveFeatures: pale growth rings on cut faces
